title: IndusInd Bank Offers Complimentary Taj Benefits to Grande & Pioneer Savings Account Holders
snippet: IndusInd Bank has introduced exclusive Taj benefits for its Indus Grande and Indus Pioneer Savings Account holders. Under this program, eligible customers can enjoy complimentary dining experiences at participating Taj Hotels or receive an Epicure Plus membership, depending on their banking relation
